name: get_info
description: Get objects in the scene. Returns names, IDs, positions [x,y,z]. Call with no params for ALL objects, or with name for specific object (partial match, case-insensitive).

name.description: Object name to search (optional). If omitted, returns all objects. Examples: 'Banana', 'robot', 'Camera'. Partial matching supported.

name: move_to_object
description: Move the robot end-effector to a specified object with optional offset. The robot will use inverse kinematics (IK) to reach the target position. Default behavior is to move 10cm above the object.

name.description: Name of the target object to move to. Must exist in the scene. Examples: 'cube', 'box', 'Rigidbody_Box'

offset_x.description: X-axis offset in meters from object center. Positive = right, Negative = left. Default: 0.0

offset_y.description: Y-axis offset in meters from object center. Positive = up, Negative = down. Default: 0.1 (10cm above object)

offset_z.description: Z-axis offset in meters from object center. Positive = forward, Negative = backward. Default: 0.0

duration.description: Movement duration in seconds. Longer duration = slower movement. Default: 2.0

name: grasp_object
description: Grasp object using magnetic attachment. Process: 1) Move to EXACTLY 10cm above object, 2) Magnetically attach object to gripper, 3) Wait 2 seconds to stabilize (prevent weird gravity effects), 4) Lift object. Object must have RigidBody enabled.

name.description: Name of the object to grasp. Examples: 'Banana', 'Banana 1', 'cube'

lift_height.description: Height to lift after grasping, in meters. Default: 0.5

name: release_object
description: Release the currently grasped object. Process: 1) (Optional) Lift gripper before release, 2) Detach object from gripper (SetParent to scene root), 3) Object falls due to gravity. Requires object has RigidBody enabled.

lift_before_release.description: Whether to lift gripper before releasing. Recommended for clearer drop effect. Default: true

lift_height.description: Height to lift before releasing, in meters. Only applies if lift_before_release is true. Default: 0.1

name: move_to_position
description: Move robot end-effector to a specific 3D position. CRITICAL: Y-axis is VERTICAL (up/down), Z-axis is forward/back. Can be absolute (world coordinates) or relative (from current position).

x.description: X coordinate (left/right) in meters. Negative=left, Positive=right. In absolute mode: world X. In relative mode: offset from current X.

y.description: Y coordinate (UP/DOWN - VERTICAL!) in meters. Negative=down, Positive=up. In absolute mode: world Y. In relative mode: offset from current Y. For 'move up': use positive Y. For 'move down': use negative Y.

z.description: Z coordinate (forward/back) in meters. Negative=backward, Positive=forward. In absolute mode: world Z. In relative mode: offset from current Z.

relative.description: If true, (x,y,z) are offsets from current position. If false, they are absolute world coordinates. Default: false

name: pick_and_place_object
description: Grasps an object, moves it to a target position, and releases it in the Unity Kinova Gen3 simulation.

name.description: Identifier or label of the object to pick up and place.

lift_height.description: Vertical distance (in meters) to lift the object after grasping, before moving horizontally.

y.description: Target Y coordinate (in meters) for placing the object in the world or relative frame.

relative.description: Whether the target (x, y, z) is interpreted as relative to the current end-effector pose (e.g., 'true' or 'false').

z.description: Target Z coordinate (in meters) for placing the object in the world or relative frame.

x.description: Target X coordinate (in meters) for placing the object in the world or relative frame.

duration.description: Time in seconds allocated for the move-to-position motion phase.

lift_before_release.description: If true, lift the object slightly before releasing it at the target; if false, release at the current height.

name: pick_up_object
description: Move the Kinova Gen3 arm to a specified object in the Unity scene, grasp it, and lift it vertically to a fixed height.

name.description: Identifier or label of the target object in the Unity environment that the robot should pick up.

lift_height.description: Vertical distance in meters to lift the object after grasping; fixed at 0.5 m above the grasp point.

name: move_gripper_around
description: Moves the robot gripper sequentially through multiple target positions in space, typically to navigate around the environment or inspect different locations.

name: move_to_all_objects_sequence
description: Sequentially move the robot arm to each detected object's position, one after another, using repeated move_to_object actions.

duration.description: Time in seconds allocated for each individual move_to_object action in the sequence.

name: line_up_all_objects
description: Pick up three separate objects one by one and place them in a straight line at the specified target coordinates.

y.description: Target Y coordinate for placing the first object (in world or relative frame, as specified by 'relative').

relative.description: Frame of reference for all target coordinates: use 'world' for absolute positions or 'relative' for positions relative to the robot/base.

z.description: Target Z coordinate (height) for placing the first object.

x.description: Target X coordinate for placing the first object.

lift_height.description: Height offset above the objects to lift them during transport (e.g., to clear obstacles).

duration.description: Approximate motion duration (in seconds) for each pick-and-place segment; fixed at 2.0.

lift_before_release.description: Whether to lift the object before releasing it at the target; fixed to false (release at final pose without an extra lift).

y_2.description: Target Y coordinate for placing the second object in the line.

z_2.description: Target Z coordinate (height) for placing the second object.

x_2.description: Target X coordinate for placing the second object in the line.

y_3.description: Target Y coordinate for placing the third object in the line.

z_3.description: Target Z coordinate (height) for placing the third object.

x_3.description: Target X coordinate for placing the third object in the line.
